article.title: Deduction in the case of an Indian company in respect of royalties, etc., received from any concern in India.
article.html:
80MMDeduction in the case of an Indian company in respect of royalties, etc., received from any concern in India.

[Omitted by the Finance Act, 1983, w.e.f. 1-4-1984. Original section was inserted by the Finance Act, 1969, w.e.f. 1-4-1970.]
